description: OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata (RFC 9728): which authorization server this knowledge base trusts, served at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource so a client — the Browser, an MCP client — learns where to send a user to sign in without configuration. A 401 from any protected route points here in its WWW-Authenticate challenge.

resource.description: This knowledge base's resource identifier: the origin the metadata was fetched from.

authorization_servers.description: Issuer identifiers whose tokens this resource accepts — the configured identity issuer.

bearer_methods_supported.description: How a bearer token reaches this resource: the Authorization header only.

resource_name.description: The knowledge base's name, for a client's sign-in prompt.
